notes: A proper What's new screen: after every update, Cutnote shows what changed, once.
Cleaner notes: each note is a card, with Done, Edit and Delete in a tidy toolbar on hover.
Hover menus: header menus with more than one option open as you hover, and the new Cutnote menu links to the website and GitHub.
Smoother Library: opening a component and going back slides in and out, and keeps your place.
Crisper controls: sliders are redrawn with a lime fill, and white-text previews sit on a plain black gradient.
